faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting online applications for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker and other posts is 16 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance to avoid any technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies announced for various posts including Anganwadi Worker, Anganwadi Helper, and Mini Anganwadi Worker under the WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026 drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Anganwadi Worker and other posts under WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026 is online. Interested candidates must submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for Anganwadi Worker posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Anganwadi Worker, Anganwadi Helper, and Mini Anganwadi Worker posts must have passed the 10th Standard examination from a recognized board.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026. The application process is free of cost.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker and other posts primarily involves an online application submission followed by a document verification stage for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the official notification for WCD Odisha Recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026 can be downloaded from the official website. A direct link to the notification is also provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website to apply for WCD Odisha jobs?
faq.answer: The official website to apply for WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker and other jobs is http://engagement-awc.odisha.gov.in. All eligible candidates should visit this portal to submit their applications.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these WCD Odisha vacancies?
faq.answer: The job type for the Anganwadi Worker, Anganwadi Helper, and Mini Anganwadi Worker posts under WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026 is contractual. These positions offer government job opportunities on a contract basis.

faq.answer: The online application process for WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026 commenced on 09 August 2023. Candidates can start applying from this date onwards until the last submission date.
